seoDescription: Most TPS students in grades 1–9 start Aug. 24, 2026, but Bowsher and Start have grade-specific exceptions. See school breaks, K–8 delays, exams, and the official calendar.
heroSummary: Most Toledo Public Schools students in grades 1–9 start Monday, August 24, 2026, most grade 10 students start August 25, and grades 11–12 start August 26. At Bowsher and Start, grade 9 starts one day later than the usual grade 9 date, and grade 10 starts one day later than the usual grade 10 date. Grades 7–8 and 11–12 follow the regular TPS dates. Preschool and kindergarten students phase in from August 24 through September 1, with all students attending September 2. Early High School Opportunity (EHSO) begins September 1, and the last day for students is May 28, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Toledo Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students in grades 1–9 start August 24, 2026, most grade 10 students start August 25, and students in grades 11–12 start August 26. At Bowsher and Start, grades 9 and 10 start one day later than the usual TPS dates for those grades. EHSO starts September 1, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend September 2 after phase-in.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Toledo Public Schools students start on the same day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. TPS staggers opening dates by grade and program. Most students begin August 24–26, EHSO begins September 1, and preschool and kindergarten students phase in before all attend September 2.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Bowsher and Start follow the usual TPS first-day schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: Not for grades 9 and 10. Bowsher and Start grade 9 begins August 25, one day later than the usual grade 9 date, and grade 10 begins August 26, one day later than the usual grade 10 date. Grades 7–8 and 11–12 follow the regular TPS dates.

calendarFaqs.q: What does EHSO mean, and when does it start?
calendarFaqs.a: EHSO means Early High School Opportunity. Its first day is Tuesday, September 1, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Are TPS K–8 delay and conference dates days off?
calendarFaqs.a: The October 16 and March 12 quarter endings are two-hour delays for K–8, not days off. K–8 students do not attend during the October 29–30 elementary parent-teacher conferences; the district calendar does not say high schools are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When are TPS Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring Breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, 2026. Winter Break runs December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027, with students returning January 5 after a teacher inservice day. Spring Break runs March 26–April 2, with classes resuming April 5, 2027.
